description: Public SL1 archive rasterization preserves stepped layer masks and physical geometry.

mutants.description: Skip drawing every transformed slice while retaining the raster callback and archive lifecycle. The stepped model area and mask assertions must fail as an ordinary physical-output assertion.
Use the first transformed print layer for every raster callback. The two lower masks may remain equal, but the required upper 16 mm2 / distinct-mask layer must fail as an ordinary assertion.
